title: OpenAI- Agentic Trading prohibited?
author: Abject-Fox-7597
selftext: I upgrade to ChatGPT pro (only way to connect to Robinhood), connected to Robinhood MCP to enable autonomous trading, only to find out ChatGPT/openAI explicitly prohibit autonomous trading? What BS is this?

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: Connecting Robinhood through ChatGPT Pro does not necessarily imply permission for unattended order placement. The useful distinction is whether the Robinhood MCP only retrieves account and market context, prepares an order for confirmation, or can actually submit one autonomously. What exact tool action or error exposed the prohibition? The wording matters here, because blocking autonomous execution while allowing read access or user-confirmed trades would be a product boundary, not a broken connection.

replies.author: Abject-Fox-7597
replies.body:
It can’t submit autonomously.  It connects successfully. ChatGPT pro pointed me to its own rules as a product boundary.  “4. High Stakes Domains  
Our policies prohibit using ChatGPT Agent for regulated activities without following applicable laws and rules. Specifically, users should not:  
Make automated decisions in sensitive domains without human involvement, including law enforcement, migration, management of critical infrastructure, safety components of products, essential services, credit, employment, housing, education, social scoring, or insurance

Automate actions like stock trading or other investment transactions”

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: I can't confirm what OpenAI's current usage policy says about autonomous trading, so the first step is to read the exact clause (usage policies and the connector or MCP terms), since "prohibited" can mean anything from financial advice limits to ordering trades without a human in the loop. If the policy does restrict it, the common workaround that stays within the rules is to have the model propose the trade and a human confirm it, with the order itself sent by a separate script that has hard limits for size, daily loss and allowed symbols. Check the broker's agent terms too, since they can differ from the model provider's. Bring Your Own Agent at Cymetica is one place to see how agents are connected to markets with limits enforced outside the model.
